description: Na₅CaFeAl₅(SiO₃)₁₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.76 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.70 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.20 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.02 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.06 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.04 Å. There are six inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-66°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the fifth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the sixth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-65°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.68 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Ca, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Fe, one Al, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaAlFeSi tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Al, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaAl₂Si tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaAl₂Si tetrahedra that share corners with three OCaAlFeSi tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaAl₂Si tetrahedra. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms.
